outputs.explanation: Panel A shows only micrographs (fluorescence images of cells with MitoTracker/DsRed/GFP staining); no averaged plot is present, so the check does not apply.
The JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity bar charts (n=20) show only mean ± error bars with no overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a western blot image with no accompanying quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
The SDH and COX signal intensity bar charts (N=15-26 per group) display only mean ± error bars without individual data points overlaid.
Panel E shows FACS histogram line plots (cell number vs TMRM intensity), a plot type exempt from requiring individual data point overlay.
